description: Control-plane error codes (02-lld §10). Each is answered as a `Problem` with this status; `remediation` is who can resolve it (common.schema.json RemediationActor). `aliases` are the existing harness and MCP codes the same cause is answered with on the legacy routes and facades.

codes.meaning: The object changed since it was read (`If-Match` does not match); read it again and retry.

nextAction.text: Someone else changed this since you opened it. Reload, then make your change again.

codes.meaning: A write without `If-Match`.

nextAction.text: Nothing to do: the client must send the version it read with its change.

codes.meaning: A layer widens a ceiling of the layer above it; `dimension` and `layer` name which.

nextAction.text: This setting asks for more than the level above allows. Ask that level's admin to raise the limit.

codes.meaning: The dimension cannot be set at this layer.

nextAction.text: This setting cannot be changed at this level. Change it where it is set instead.

codes.meaning: A choice outside the ceiling that governs it.

nextAction.text: This choice is outside what is allowed here. Pick a value within the allowed range.

codes.meaning: A layer above locked the setting (C4.02); `dimension` names it and `layer` the layer that tried to change it. Only the admins of the locking layer can change it.

nextAction.text: An admin above locked this setting. Ask that admin to change or unlock it.

codes.meaning: A layer refers to something the org does not have (a user group or user, an installation, a configured model, an engine kind); the message names it.

nextAction.text: This refers to something your organization does not have. Pick an existing item instead.

codes.meaning: A configuration does not validate: an installation's for its kind (a domain module's ConfigValidator), or a policy layer's value for its dimension (the resolver's `invalid` refusal); the message names the field.

nextAction.text: Some settings are not valid. Fix the fields shown and save again.

codes.meaning: The authorizer denied the action.

nextAction.text: You do not have permission for this. Ask your admin.

codes.meaning: No such object in the caller's org (an object of another org is reported the same way, so ids do not leak).

nextAction.text: This item no longer exists. Reload to see the current list.

codes.meaning: The item is not installed in this org.

nextAction.text: This app is not installed in your organization. Ask your admin to install it.

codes.meaning: The installation is disabled.

nextAction.text: This app is turned off. Ask your admin to turn it on.

codes.meaning: The installation, or this tool of it, is not approved.

nextAction.text: This app or tool is not approved yet. Ask your admin to approve it.

codes.meaning: The installation is not visible to the acting user.

nextAction.text: This app is not shared with you. Ask your team's admin for access.

codes.meaning: The agent is not granted the installation or the tool.

nextAction.text: This agent is not allowed to use that app or tool. Ask the agent's owner to add it.

codes.meaning: No credential is bound for this installation and owner.

nextAction.text: No account is connected for this app. Connect it, then try again.

codes.meaning: The bound credential expired and could not be refreshed.

nextAction.text: The connection to this app expired. Connect it again, then try again.

codes.meaning: The bound credential was revoked.

nextAction.text: The connection to this app was revoked. Connect it again, then try again.

codes.meaning: Policy does not allow this kind of item.

nextAction.text: Your organization's policy does not allow this kind of app. Ask your admin.

codes.meaning: The approval's target changed since the request was made.

nextAction.text: What this approval was for changed. Reload and decide on the current request.

codes.meaning: A tool's live descriptor differs from the pinned one; answered as a tool result.

nextAction.text: This tool changed since it was approved. Ask your admin to review and approve it again.

codes.meaning: The effective set is larger than the cap.

nextAction.text: This agent has more tools than it may use at once. Remove some apps or tools from it.

codes.meaning: The admission head moved while pinning; internal, admission pins again.

nextAction.text: Nothing to do: the settings changed while the run started, so it reads them again.

codes.meaning: A store or cache is unavailable under a fail-closed rule.

nextAction.text: Settings could not be checked just now, so nothing was done. Wait a moment, then try again.

codes.meaning: The org's kill switch is on.

nextAction.text: Your organization stopped all agent work for now. Ask your admin.
